student_architecture.shared_board_encoder: one shared Conv2d 43 to 16, 3x3, padding 1, no bias; GroupNorm 4 and GELU; two residual blocks each with two bias-free 16-channel 3x3 convolutions and GroupNorm 4; flatten 16x9x9; Linear 1296 to 128; LayerNorm 128; apply the identical weights once to the parent and to every valid legal child
student_architecture.per_move_feature: concatenate parent 128, child 128, child-minus-parent 128, the 208 move-embedding values, and tanh(base_parent_cp / 3000), for exactly 593 values
student_architecture.input_projection: Linear 593 to 256 with bias, LayerNorm 256, GELU
student_architecture.residual_mlp: two blocks; each block is Linear 256 to 512 with bias, GELU, Linear 512 to 256 with bias, residual add, LayerNorm 256, GELU
student_architecture.output: Linear 256 to 1 with bias gives residual_units; residual_cp = 600 * residual_units; combined_parent_cp = base_parent_cp + residual_cp where base_parent_cp = -child_side_to_move_live_nnue_cp; invalid padding is zeroed and never ranked
student_architecture.move_set_semantics: independent shared scoring over moves with no positional embedding; stable descending combined-CP sort and bytewise-USI ascending tie break make the output permutation-equivariant

pinned_feature_sources.role: side-to-move SFEN normalization, 28 board planes, and 14 hand counts
explicit move parsing and piece/category maps
move indices, child transition, live-NNUE scoring, and parent-perspective sign
43-plane parent/child tensors, padding, and source child16x2 encoder geometry

exact_forward_contract.dtype: IEEE-754 float32 for every plane, embedding, weight, bias, activation, normalization statistic, residual, and CP tensor; categorical indices are signed int64 in Python and exact nonnegative int32 in runtime

plane_map.board: train.parse_sfen produces side-to-move-normalized feature in [0,2267]; piece_plane = feature // 81, square = feature % 81, y = square // 9, x = square % 9, and plane[piece_plane,y,x] = 1
plane_map.hand: planes 28..41 follow HAND_ORDER PLNSGBR for friendly then enemy counts in the exact train.parse_sfen order; divide by maxima [18,4,4,4,4,2,2] repeated twice and fill all 9x9 cells
plane_map.ply: plane 42 fills all cells with min(max(int(SFEN ply)-1,0),255)/255
plane_map.child: derive canonical child SFEN with child_sfen_after_usi and apply the identical 43-plane mapping from the child's new side-to-move perspective
plane_map.flatten: contiguous C-major then y then x; flatten index = channel*81 + y*9 + x

move_index_map.from_square: side-to-move normalized (file-1)*9+(rank-1) in [0,80], with drop sentinel 81
move_index_map.captured_piece: 0 for none, otherwise exact destination piece map in [1,14]
move_index_map.delta_file_and_rank: for non-drop destination minus source after normalization, clipped to [-8,8] then plus 8; drops use delta zero then index 8
move_index_map.king_relation: clip(to_file-king_file)+8 multiplied by 17 plus clip(to_rank-king_rank)+8, separately for friendly and enemy king, in [0,288]
move_index_map.padding: valid false, all indices zero, all planes and CP zero; padding never enters normalization statistics, loss, or sorting

live_nnue_sign_and_scale.child_side_cp: exact deployed integer score_child_sfens_with_live_nnue output in the child side-to-move view using K=600 and truncation toward zero

normalization.group_norm: 4 contiguous groups over 16 channels; per sample and group reduce channel-within-group,y,x; population variance with correction=0; epsilon 0.00001 inside sqrt; affine channel weight then bias
normalization.layer_norm: normalize the final feature axis only; population variance with correction=0; epsilon 0.00001 inside sqrt; affine element weight then bias

operation_order: shared board stem Conv2d -> GroupNorm -> GELU
for each of two board blocks: save residual -> Conv2d -> GroupNorm -> GELU -> Conv2d -> GroupNorm -> residual add -> GELU
concatenate parent, child, child-minus-parent, embeddings in the JSON key order, then tanh(base_parent_cp/3000)
for each of two MLP blocks: save residual -> Linear 256 to 512 -> GELU -> Linear 512 to 256 -> residual add -> LayerNorm -> GELU
Linear 256 to 1 -> multiply 600 -> add base_parent_cp -> mask invalid -> stable descending sort with bytewise-USI ascending tie break

distillation_objective.target: frozen seed-42 combined move CP on fit parents only
distillation_objective.notation: for valid move i, T_i is frozen seed-42 combined parent-perspective CP and S_i is student combined_parent_cp; m=max_i T_i
distillation_objective.listwise: P_i=softmax_i(clamp(T_i-m,-2000,0)/100); L_list(parent)=-sum_i P_i*log_softmax_i(S/100); arithmetic mean over parents, weight 1.0
distillation_objective.pair: E={(i,j):T_i-T_j>=50}; L_pair=mean over every ordered pair in E across the current single-domain microbatch of softplus(-(S_i-S_j)/100); if E is empty, differentiable exact zero; weight 1.0
distillation_objective.tie_aware_hardest_negative_margin: B={i:T_i=m}, N={i:T_i<m}; if N nonempty L_margin(parent)=ReLU(50-(max_{i in B}S_i-max_{j in N}S_j))/100, else differentiable exact zero; arithmetic mean over parents, weight 1.0
distillation_objective.move_value: for each parent take the arithmetic mean over valid moves of SmoothL1(clamp(S_i,-3000,3000)/600,clamp(T_i,-3000,3000)/600,beta=0.25); arithmetic mean over parents, weight 0.20
distillation_objective.domain_combination: for each Browser or V9 microbatch compute L_domain=mean(L_list)+L_pair+mean(L_margin)+0.20*mean(L_move); Browser and V9 remain separate and their present microbatch domain losses are summed; no cross-domain softmax, pair, or averaging
distillation_objective.optimizer_order: forward -> summed domain loss -> optimizer zero_grad(set_to_none=true) before backward -> backward -> clip global L2 gradient norm to 5 -> AdamW step; no loss scaling or gradient accumulation unless byte-exactly fixed before optimizer

source_binding.selection: sort each clean parent by sha256('capacity-sealed-v1:' + parent_id), take at most four per game, then take the lowest 512 globally
source_binding.labels: generate independent depth-12 YaneuraOu labels under the parent contract, retain exactly the pinned projected production move membership for scoring, and record both source and retained list hashes; the frozen neural teachers are separately re-forwarded on each complete projected set
source_binding.label_resume: before any candidate inference only, independently completed shards may resume by exact content address over parent membership, teacher binary/eval/config, depth, legal enumerator, and bound parent protocol; valid shards are immutable and one atomic final receipt must bind exactly 512 parents and ordered shard hashes

one_shot_sealed.open_only_after: all three frozen artifacts independently pass the one-shot tune and remain byte-identical
one_shot_sealed.atomic_scoring_result: score all three frozen artifacts without partial publication and atomically publish one complete result; partial or incomplete scoring closes the lane without resume, rerun, or result completion
one_shot_sealed.pass_authorizes_only: one execution of the fixed parity-1024, M4 Pro latency, and runtime static/determinism/no-leaf-TT-contamination admission gates on the already frozen student
one_shot_sealed.any_miss: close before parity, latency, formal, external, or live change

legacy_boundary.inherit_only: 384 color-swapped opening pairs, 768 games, fixed search controls, zero-fault analyzability, and pair bootstrap seed 20260710 with 100000 replicates
legacy_boundary.do_not_inherit: the legacy single-NNUE-weight candidate adapter or registry identity

new_registry.creation_authority: only after tune, sealed, parity-1024, M4 Pro latency, static, determinism, and no-contamination gates all pass for the unchanged frozen student

master_runtime_config.creation: after complete-runtime-admitted-formal-locked, atomically publish one canonical UTF-8 LF JSON object binding all student, NNUE, opening-book, source, emitted-build, feature, adapter, search, fault, parity, and latency receipts
master_runtime_config.formal_mode: fixed depth 11, quiescence 10, K=600, TT clear before every move, opening book disabled, fallback disabled, clocks disabled, maximum 512 plies
master_runtime_config.external_mode: student enabled, exact production search defaults, official-client 10m+30s clock input, exact external opening book enabled, fail-closed stable root ordering on a typed student fault
master_runtime_config.receipt: resolved path, bytes, SHA-256, schema, producing public-main Git commit, and production build manifest SHA-256 freeze before formal game 1

candidate_adapter.role: load the frozen student at root only while preserving the exact live NNUE at every static-evaluation call

must_bind_exact_receipts.production_worker_chunk: resolved emitted worker asset path from the exact candidate production build
must_bind_exact_receipts.production_wasm_asset: resolved emitted WASM asset path from the exact candidate production build

candidate_adapter.receipt_fields: each bound file requires resolved path, bytes, SHA-256, schema or media type, and producing public-main Git/build commit
required_build_provenance: student-capable worker source and emitted chunk hashes
student-capable WASM source and emitted asset hashes
candidate_adapter.any_drift: STOP before game 1 or mark all formal games faulted and unanalyzable

formal_candidate_adapter_registry.formal_candidate: the exact bound student plus unchanged live NNUE plus exact student-capable worker/WASM build

formal_stable.adapter: the exact same worker, WASM, live NNUE, production build, source commit, master runtime config, search controls, and asset receipts as candidate
formal_stable.only_difference: student_enabled is false instead of true at the root adapter boundary
formal_stable.requirements: zero student tensor reads and zero student inference calls; stable root input order is preserved byte-for-byte
formal_stable.forbidden: a separately built stable binary, different worker/WASM, different NNUE, different master config, or a legacy single-weight adapter

formal_candidate_adapter_registry.role_adapter_receipts: atomically publish candidate and stable canonical configs; their parsed trees must be identical except the single boolean /student_enabled, and record path/bytes/SHA-256 plus a machine diff proving that one difference
formal_candidate_adapter_registry.result_authority: only the parent protocol's exact 384-pair/768-game stronger-claim gate can authorize external calibration

external_candidate_provenance.execution_authority: only after the parent formal two-sided 95 percent lower bound is strictly above 0.50 with zero faults
required_assets_before_game1: student tensor resolved path, bytes, and SHA-256
student manifest resolved path, bytes, and SHA-256
unchanged live NNUE resolved path, bytes, and SHA-256
exact external opening book resolved path, bytes, and SHA-256
master runtime config resolved path, bytes, SHA-256, schema, and public-main commit
student-capable worker source and emitted chunk resolved paths, bytes, and SHA-256
student-capable WASM source and emitted asset resolved paths, bytes, and SHA-256
production build manifest path, bytes, SHA-256, and public-main Git commit
student formal registry and candidate-adapter paths, bytes, SHA-256, and commit
formal result path, bytes, SHA-256, candidate identity, and trace provenance

external_opening_book.mode: enabled only under the master runtime config external_mode; formal mode remains book-disabled

external_candidate_provenance.master_runtime_config_provenance: every external trace binds the admitted canonical master config receipt, its external_mode, the exact production build manifest, and the candidate role adapter; no UI default or ambient config may override it
external_candidate_provenance.candidate_trace: every external game binds the exact student, live NNUE, worker, WASM, build, registry, adapter, account, client, hardware, time control, and game record identities
external_candidate_provenance.drift_or_missing: STOP; no external claim or substitution

staged_authority.pass: both teacher hashes are mechanically bound and this otherwise unchanged core is merged to public main
the fixed final student checkpoint and every runtime artifact hash freeze with no tune or sealed access
staged_authority.authorizes_only: the parent one-shot tune for both teachers and the student

staged_authority.pass: all three artifacts independently pass every one-shot tune check
staged_authority.authorizes_only: parent sealed-512 generation and one-shot scoring

staged_authority.pass: all three artifacts independently pass every sealed-512 check
staged_authority.authorizes_only: one bound runtime-admission invocation containing parity-1024, M4 Pro latency, static call-graph, determinism, fail-closed, and no-leaf-TT-contamination cases

staged_authority.pass: the frozen student passes the atomic runtime-admission result and the same-build stable/candidate configs differ only by student_enabled
staged_authority.authorizes_only: freeze of the master runtime config and student formal adapter/registry, then enrollment of those exact receipts in the parent's formal 384-pair/768-game direct A/B

staged_authority.pass: the parent formal stronger-claim gate passes
staged_authority.authorizes_only: the parent's exact 200-game external calibration; no live write

failure_conditions: STOP before any student work if the parent protocol, phase-1 terminal result, teacher seed, teacher hash, fit partition, protected union, live NNUE, architecture, parameter count, initialization, objective, schedule, path, or artifact contract drifts.
STOP if either unresolved teacher placeholder remains, if any value other than the two permitted hash strings changed during binding, or if the binding commit is not on public main.
STOP if any tune, sealed, sentinel, seed-314159, direct-play, external, or post-result data enters labels, initialization, training, export, parity-fixture selection, or debugging.
STOP if training does not finish the fixed mixed epoch 12 final checkpoint; do not open tune.
STOP if any required artifact lacks an exact path/byte/SHA receipt before tune.
STOP on any one-shot tune miss without sealed generation.
STOP on any one-shot sealed miss without parity, latency, or formal execution.
STOP on a partial, incomplete, or failed runtime-admission result without resume, rerun, registry creation, or formal direct A/B.
STOP on any parity, latency, static, determinism, fail-closed, contamination, hash, manifest, source/build, master-config, or runtime fault without formal direct A/B.
No pass in this protocol changes public/shogi-nnue-weights.bin or authorizes a live deployment.
